plugin.name: Bend2
plugin.description:
Language support for Bend 2 in IntelliJ IDEA.
  • Syntax highlighting, hash line comments, and editable snippets
  • Completion for declarations, local bindings, Base, imports, and import paths
  • Go to Declaration, Go to Symbol, Find Usages, and source Quick Documentation
  • Manual and optional background compiler checking of unsaved source and imports
Editing works without a Bend installation. Checking requires a configured Bend compiler with --check-only support. See the README for setup and current limitations.
plugin.change-notes:
Version 0.1.4:

  • Add a Bend structure view, source-preserving formatting, and binding-aware rename
  • Search workspace declarations with Go to Symbol
  • Make compiler checks more reliable with pinned offline test inputs, current-only results, conservative verdicts, and exact imported-source mapping
  • Remove IntelliJ Internal API usages reported by Plugin Verifier
